Picked nSuns 5/3/1 LP (4-day): nSuns is a 4+ day training-max wave built for an intermediate or more advanced lifter with a barbell, more volume than GZCLP asks for. T1 Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip starts at 205 lb (from 225x5, e1RM 228 lb after form allowance). T1 Barbell Squat starts at 285 lb (from 315x5, e1RM 319 lb after form allowance). T1 Standing Military Press starts at 120 lb (from 135x5, e1RM 137 lb after form allowance). T1 Barbell Deadlift starts at 345 lb (from 405x3, e1RM 386 lb after form allowance).
